# ROADMAP 13.4's gate and window follow the operator's under-25 weekend cut

## Context

On 2026-11-06 the operator moved the 13.4 cut. His words, quoted on the planning draft at 17:4x CET: *"engine already down to 84 open tickets. gut feeling: if we are fast, next engine release saturday evening, otherwise sunday."* The release gate is under 25 open Engine issues, his direction for the householding, relayed on #15000's thread and on the planning draft. `ROADMAP.md` still says the opposite on both counts.

## The Problem

`ROADMAP.md` § Next: Engine 13.4 is the canonical next-release scope, and every seat reads its gate before a cut. Two of its lines are stale:
- **Gate (line 27):** "fewer open issues at the cut than the 103 of 2026-11-06". 84 open already satisfies that, so the stated gate no longer constrains anything.
- **Window (line 43):** "around 2026-11-19". The cut is now this weekend.

## The Architectural Reality

Documentation only: `ROADMAP.md`, lines 27 and 43. No code, workflow or `publish.mjs` behavior changes. The section is replaced as a whole at the next post-release roadmap update, so this correction lives until the cut.

## The Fix

- Line 27: the gate becomes fewer than 25 open Engine issues at the cut, keeping 103 on 2026-11-06 as the baseline and the delivered-or-closed-with-a-reason clause.
- Line 43: 13.4 is cut by `publish.mjs` once the gate holds, aiming for Saturday 2026-11-07 evening, else Sunday 2026-11-08.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ROADMAP.md`'s 13.4 gate names fewer than 25 open issues, with the 103 baseline kept.
- [ ] Its window names this weekend instead of 2026-11-19.

## Out of Scope

- The milestone, the epics table and the deferred list.
- The post-release roadmap for the next line.

## Related

- PR #20464 carries the change.
- #20401 wrote the section.
- #15000 is the householding sweep the gate measures.
